# Software Development and IP Assignment Agreement

This Agreement is between **Fernhill Wellness, Inc.**, a Delaware corporation ("**Fernhill**"), and **Orbitmade Studio LLC**, a New Jersey limited liability company ("**Orbitmade**"). It is effective as of [DATE].

## 1. Definitions

- **"App"**: Fernhill's iOS and Android sleep-tracking application described in the SOW.
- **"Deliverables"**: all code (source and object), designs, documentation and other materials that Orbitmade or its Personnel create under this Agreement. Deliverables exclude Orbitmade Core.
- **"Orbitmade Core"**: the pre-existing UI and networking libraries listed in Schedule B, including any modifications.
- **"Copyleft License"**: any license that requires disclosure or royalty-free licensing of source code of works combined with or derived from the licensed code. Examples include the GPL, LGPL and AGPL.
- **"User Data"**: data relating to App users, including sleep, heart-rate and wearable data.
- **"Personnel"**: Orbitmade's employees and approved Subcontractors.

## 2. Services and Statement of Work

2.1 Orbitmade will perform the services described in Schedule A (the "**SOW**") in a professional manner consistent with industry standards.

2.2 Changes require a written change order signed by both parties.

2.3 Orbitmade will make the App live in the Apple App Store and Google Play under Fernhill's developer accounts by **June 30, 2026** (the "**Launch Date**").
- The Launch Date extends day-for-day only for delays caused by Fernhill missing an SOW dependency, after Orbitmade gives written notice.
- [Delay credit: [__]% of the M4 fee per week of delay, capped at [__]%.]

2.4 Orbitmade will commit all code at least weekly to a repository controlled by Fernhill.

## 3. Fees and Milestones

3.1 The fixed fee is **$250,000** (the "**Fee**"). It includes all expenses and Subcontractor costs.

| Milestone | Fee |
|---|---|
| M1 Discovery | $25,000 |
| M2 Design | $50,000 |
| M3 Beta | $90,000 |
| M4 Store Launch | $80,000 [of which $[20,000] is payable when the Warranty Period ends] |

3.2 Orbitmade invoices each Milestone when it is Accepted. Fernhill will pay undisputed amounts within 30 days.
- Fernhill may withhold disputed amounts in good faith if it gives a written explanation.
- Orbitmade may suspend work only if undisputed amounts remain unpaid 15 days after notice.

## 4. Acceptance

4.1 Fernhill has 15 business days after each delivery (the "**Test Period**") to test the delivery against the SOW acceptance criteria. Within that time, Fernhill will either accept or give written notice of nonconformities.

4.2 Orbitmade will correct and redeliver within 10 business days. A new Test Period then applies.

4.3 If a Milestone fails a [second] time, Fernhill may choose one of the following:
- (a) continue the correction process;
- (b) accept the Milestone with an equitable Fee reduction; or
- (c) terminate under Section 10.2 and receive a refund of fees paid for the rejected Milestone.

4.4 If Fernhill does not respond within the Test Period, Orbitmade may send a reminder notice. The Milestone is deemed accepted if Fernhill does not respond within 5 business days after that notice.

4.5 Public commercial release constitutes Acceptance of M4. Acceptance does not waive any warranty.

## 5. Intellectual Property

5.1 **Assignment.**
- Fernhill owns all Deliverables upon creation.
- To the extent permitted under 17 U.S.C. §101, the Deliverables are works made for hire.
- Orbitmade **hereby irrevocably assigns** to Fernhill all right, title and interest in the Deliverables. This includes all copyrights, patent rights and trade secrets, and the right to sue for past infringement.
- Orbitmade waives moral rights and will cause its Personnel to waive them.
- This Agreement is a signed instrument of conveyance under 17 U.S.C. §204(a).

5.2 **Personnel.** Before any Personnel work on the App, Orbitmade will obtain from them written present assignments sufficient to give effect to Section 5.1. Orbitmade will provide copies on request.

5.3 **Further Assurances.** Orbitmade will sign any documents reasonably required to perfect Fernhill's rights. If Orbitmade fails to do so within 10 days of request, Fernhill is appointed its attorney-in-fact solely to sign them.

5.4 **Orbitmade Core.**
- Orbitmade retains ownership of Orbitmade Core.
- Orbitmade grants Fernhill and its affiliates and successors a license to use, modify and distribute Orbitmade Core, in source and object form, with or for the App and its derivatives. The license is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and non-exclusive. It is sublicensable to contractors and transferable with the App.
- This license survives any termination.
- Orbitmade will deliver Orbitmade Core source code.
- Orbitmade will not incorporate any other pre-existing material without Fernhill's written consent.

5.5 **Open Source.**
- Orbitmade may use only the open-source components listed in Schedule C, and will comply with their licenses.
- Orbitmade may not use any Copyleft License component without Fernhill's prior written consent specifically referencing this Section.
- [SleepWave (GPL-3.0) is **not approved**. Orbitmade will provide a functionally equivalent component under a permissive or commercial license, at no additional cost.]

5.6 **Fernhill Materials.** Fernhill's own materials remain Fernhill's. They are licensed to Orbitmade solely to perform the services.

## 6. Data Security and Subcontractors

6.1 **Use of User Data.** Orbitmade will process User Data only to perform the services and as Fernhill instructs in writing. Orbitmade will comply with all applicable law, including:
- the FTC Act;
- the FTC Health Breach Notification Rule (16 C.F.R. Part 318);
- the New York SHIELD Act; and
- state consumer-health-data laws.

6.2 **Security Program.** Orbitmade will maintain a written security program that meets [OWASP MASVS / SOC 2] standards. The program must include:
- encryption in transit and at rest;
- least-privilege access; and
- secure development practices.

6.3 **Test Data.** Testing will use synthetic or de-identified data only. Orbitmade will not access production User Data without Fernhill's written consent.

6.4 **Security Incidents.** Orbitmade will notify Fernhill of any security incident within [48] hours and will cooperate in the response. Orbitmade will bear notification and remediation costs to the extent the incident was caused by Orbitmade or its Personnel.

6.5 **Subcontractors.**
- Orbitmade may use only the Subcontractors and countries approved in Schedule D [offshore QA: name and country].
- Each Subcontractor must be bound in writing by obligations at least as protective as this Agreement.
- No User Data may leave the United States.
- Orbitmade is liable for its Subcontractors' acts and omissions as if they were its own.

6.6 **Return and Deletion.** On termination, Orbitmade will return or delete all User Data and certify that it has done so.

6.7 **Insurance.** Orbitmade will maintain technology E&O and cyber insurance of at least $[2,000,000] each.

## 7. Warranties

7.1 Orbitmade warrants that:
- (a) the Deliverables will conform to the SOW for [90] days after M4 Acceptance (the "**Warranty Period**"), and Orbitmade will correct any nonconformity at no charge;
- (b) the Deliverables and Orbitmade Core are original and do not infringe or misappropriate third-party rights;
- (c) the App contains no malicious code and no undisclosed tracking or analytics SDKs;
- (d) Schedule C is complete;
- (e) at submission, the App complies with Apple and Google store policies; and
- (f) Orbitmade has obtained all Personnel assignments required by Section 5.2.

7.2 Each party warrants that it has authority to enter into this Agreement. All other warranties are disclaimed.

## 8. Indemnities

8.1 **By Orbitmade.** Orbitmade will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Fernhill against third-party claims arising from:
- (a) infringement by the Deliverables or Orbitmade Core;
- (b) breach of Section 5.5 or Section 6; or
- (c) gross negligence or willful misconduct by Orbitmade or its Personnel.

Claims arising from Fernhill Materials or Fernhill modifications are excluded.

8.2 **By Fernhill.** Fernhill will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Orbitmade against third-party claims arising from Fernhill Materials, or from Fernhill's operation of the App to the extent the claim is not covered by Section 8.1.

8.3 **Infringement Remedy.** For infringing items, Orbitmade will also, at its expense, procure the necessary rights for Fernhill or modify or replace the items so they do not infringe.

8.4 **Procedure.** The indemnified party will give prompt notice and reasonable cooperation. The indemnifying party controls the defense. No settlement may admit fault by the indemnified party without its consent.

## 9. Limitation of Liability

9.1 **Exclusion of Damages.** Except for Excluded Claims, neither party is liable for indirect, consequential or punitive damages or lost profits.

9.2 **General Cap.** Except for Excluded Claims and Section 9.3, each party's aggregate liability will not exceed [1x/2x] the Fee.

9.3 **Data Cap.** Liability for breach of Section 6, and under Section 8.1(b) for data claims, is subject to a separate cap of [$______ / 3x the Fee].

9.4 **Excluded Claims.** Sections 9.1 and 9.2 do not apply to:
- Section 8.1(a) indemnity;
- breach of Section 5.1–5.3;
- gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud; or
- Fernhill's undisputed payment obligations.

## 10. Term and Termination

10.1 **Term.** This Agreement continues until the Warranty Period expires and all fees are paid.

10.2 **For Cause.** Either party may terminate for material breach that remains uncured 30 days after notice. Fernhill may also terminate immediately if M4 is not delivered within [30] days after the Launch Date.

10.3 **For Convenience.** Fernhill may terminate on 15 days' notice. Fernhill will then pay for:
- all Accepted Milestones; and
- a pro-rata share of the in-progress Milestone, based on documented completion and capped at [50]%.

10.4 **On Any Termination.** Within 5 business days, Orbitmade will deliver all Deliverables in their current form, including:
- source code and build scripts;
- design files and documentation; and
- credentials and signing keys.

Orbitmade will also return or delete User Data. Orbitmade will provide [30] days of transition assistance at [rates]. Transition assistance is free if termination results from Orbitmade's breach.

Section 5 (including the Orbitmade Core license) survives termination for any reason. Fernhill's sole obligation as a condition of these rights is paying undisputed amounts due.

10.5 **Survival.** Sections 5–9, 10.4, 11 and 12 survive termination.

## 11. Non-Solicitation

During the term and for 12 months afterward, neither party will solicit for employment or engagement any employee or contractor of the other party who was materially involved in the App project. This Section does not restrict:
- general solicitations not targeted at those individuals; or
- hiring anyone who responds to a general solicitation.

## 12. Governing Law and Venue

12.1 New York law governs, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles.

12.2 The state and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.

12.3 **Each party waives trial by jury.**

12.4 Either party may seek injunctive relief in any court for breach of Section 5, Section 6 or confidentiality obligations.

## 13. Additional Sections (headings only)

Confidentiality; Independent Contractor; Notices; Assignment; Force Majeure; Entire Agreement; Amendment and Waiver; Severability; Order of Precedence; Counterparts and E-Signatures; Schedules A (SOW), B (Orbitmade Core), C (Open Source), D (Subcontractors).

*[Signature blocks. The agreement must be signed by an authorized officer of Orbitmade for §204(a).]*

**To:** John Doe
**Subject:** Orbitmade agreement – draft and open points

John,

The draft is attached. Here are the main places where I departed from your term sheet:

1. **Work for hire.** Commissioned software generally falls outside the Copyright Act's work-for-hire categories. I added a present assignment, plus assignments from Orbitmade's staff and subcontractors. That is what actually gives you ownership.
2. **Acceptance.** "Until we're happy" invites dispute and slows payment. Orbitmade's 5-day deemed acceptance is too short. I used a 15-day test window, fix cycles, and a refund right on repeated failure.
3. **Liability.** Unlimited liability is unrealistic for a small agency, and its 3-month cap is far too low. I proposed a fee-based cap, a higher separate cap for data breaches, and uncapped IP infringement.
4. **SleepWave (GPL-3.0).** It could force you to publish app source code and may conflict with App Store terms. The draft rejects it.

**Decisions needed:**

- Cap level (1x or 2x the fee) and the data-breach cap amount
- Whether to allow SleepWave or require a replacement
- Whether to approve offshore QA (vendor names and countries)
- Delay credits and the M4 holdback amount
- Warranty length (90 days?)
- Insurance minimums

Also, sleep and heart-rate data likely falls under the FTC Health Breach Notification Rule even though HIPAA doesn't apply. Let's discuss your privacy policy.

Best,
[Name]
